name: mendday
description: A twelve-week self-directed growth programme that runs entirely in your browser.

scripts.package: node build.mjs && cd docs && zip -rq ../mendday-site.zip . -x '.*' && cd .. && echo 'wrote mendday-site.zip'
scripts.package:landing: cd landing && zip -rq ../mendday-landing.zip . -x '.*' && cd .. && echo 'wrote mendday-landing.zip'
scripts.test: node build.mjs && node test/tailoring.mjs && node test/mcp.mjs
scripts.test:browser: node test/deep.mjs && node test/smoke.mjs && node test/persistence.mjs && node test/pwa.mjs && node test/backup.mjs
